description: Results of a search query against an OpenSearch index. The set of populated fields is governed by the request's responseParts: hits and offset are populated by default; the remaining fields are populated only when the corresponding SearchQueryPart is requested.

hits.description: Matching documents. Populated by default (or whenever SearchQueryPart.HITS is requested).

totalHits.description: The total number of matching documents. Populated when SearchQueryPart.TOTAL_HITS is requested.

selectColumns.description: The columns represented in each hit's fields, in SELECT-clause order. Populated when SearchQueryPart.SELECT_COLUMNS is requested. When SearchQuery.returnFields is non-empty, this is the subset of columns matching those names.

aggregationResults.description: The raw OpenSearch aggregations response as a JSON string — the contents of the aggregations key returned by AOSS, with field references rewritten back to column names. Populated when SearchQuery.aggregations was supplied. Returned as an opaque JSON string because the OpenSearch DSL produces a wide variety of bucket shapes (per-aggregation-type and per-sub-aggregation); typing each shape would re-introduce the structured-to-DSL translation layer this surface replaces.

suggestResults.description: The raw OpenSearch suggester response as a JSON string — the contents of the suggest key returned by AOSS, with field references rewritten back to column names. Populated when SearchQuery.suggest was supplied.

nextSearchAfter.description: Opaque cursor for the next page when the request used searchAfter (or asked for hits with a sort that produced a full page). Pass back unchanged on the next request as SearchQuery.searchAfter. Null when there are no further pages.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset echoed from the request. Always populated.
